preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of edges m must be at least n - 1 and at most 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ci <= 10000 for ai, bi, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: The flow volume ci for each edge must be between 1 and 10,000.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(ci for ai, bi, ci in edges if bi == v) == sum(ci for ai, bi, ci in edges if ai == v) for v in range(2, n))
postconditions.description: For each vertex v (1 < v < n), the sum of incoming flow must equal the sum of outgoing flow.

postconditions.expression: all(bi != 1 for ai, bi, ci in edges)
postconditions.description: Vertex 1 must have no incoming edges.

postconditions.expression: not any(cycle for cycle in detect_cycles(edges))
postconditions.description: The directed graph must not contain any cycles.
